# ArchSpex.com

> ArchSpex is the GCC and Middle East's premier building materials specification platform, connecting architects, interior designers, contractors, and project developers with verified international manufacturers. Based in Dubai, UAE, ArchSpex enables construction professionals to discover specification-ready products, download BIM and CAD files, request samples, and submit RFQs — all in one professional workspace.

## About

ArchSpex.com is operated by GTV Global L.L.C. in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The platform serves the construction, architecture, and interior design industries across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) — including the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Saudi Arabia (KSA), Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain — as well as the wider Middle East region.

The platform bridges the gap between international building material manufacturers and the architects, designers, and contractors who specify products for real construction projects in the Gulf. Unlike global directories, ArchSpex is curated specifically for the GCC market, with every brand and product reviewed for quality and relevance.

## What ArchSpex offers

- **Product Discovery**: Browse verified building materials across six categories — Structure, Envelope, Interiors, Finishes, FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment), and Systems.
- **Brand & Manufacturer Directory**: Explore profiles of leading international manufacturers active in the GCC construction market.
- **BIM & Technical Downloads**: Access BIM objects, CAD drawings, technical datasheets, certifications, and installation guides.
- **Product Comparison**: Compare products side by side based on technical data, certifications, dimensions, and applications.
- **RFQ & Sample Requests**: Submit requests for quotations and product samples directly to manufacturers.
- **Project Gallery**: View real architecture and construction projects across the UAE and GCC, along with the products and brands used.
- **Professional Directory**: Connect with architects, interior designers, contractors, and consultants across the region.
- **For Manufacturers**: List products, generate qualified leads, host technical files, and reach specifiers across the Gulf market.

## Who uses ArchSpex

- Architects and architectural firms in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the GCC
- Interior designers and design studios
- Contractors, buyers, and procurement teams
- Project developers and real estate developers
- MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) and specification consultants
- International building material manufacturers seeking GCC market entry

## Product categories

- **Structure**: Structural steel, precast concrete elements, timber structures, reinforcement systems, foundations
- **Envelope**: Curtain wall systems, facade cladding, windows and glazing, roofing, waterproofing, insulation
- **Interiors**: Glass partitions, ceiling systems, raised access floors, acoustic systems, wall systems
- **Finishes**: Floor finishes, wall finishes, tiles and stone, surface panels, coatings and paints, wood and veneer
- **FF&E**: Furniture, lighting, sanitaryware, kitchens, fixtures, appliances
- **Systems**: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, building automation, elevators and escalators, smart systems

## For manufacturers and brands

Manufacturers interested in listing products and reaching GCC specifiers can apply through the For Brands section at https://archspex.com/#forbrands. ArchSpex offers tiered membership plans with product listings, BIM file hosting, featured placement, lead generation, and analytics.
